risks.risk: Hidden physical damage (e.g., cracks on front screen or edges, water damage)
risks.proof: A clear photo of the front screen and all edges of the phone, ideally with a close-up of the screen for any micro-cracks or discoloration.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having potential hidden damage, which may reduce value by 10-20%.

risks.risk: Battery performance issues beyond 85% capacity (e.g., throttling, rapid drain)
risks.proof: A video showing the phone in use for 30 minutes with battery usage stats, or a test of performance under load (e.g., gaming, video recording).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially degraded performance, which may reduce value by 10-15%.

risks.risk: Software or hardware malfunction not visible in static photos (e.g., camera not working, speaker issue, touch screen failure)
risks.proof: A video demonstrating all major functions: camera, speaker, microphone, touch response, and connectivity (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially non-functional, which may reduce value by 30-50%.

risks.risk: Unlocked status or carrier lock (if not confirmed)
risks.proof: A screenshot of the 'Carrier' or 'Network' settings showing 'No SIM' or 'Unlocked', or a video of the phone being used with a different SIM card.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially locked, which may reduce value by 10-25%.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the front screen and all edges of the phone to confirm no cracks or damage.
A video showing the phone in use: camera, speaker, microphone, touch response, and connectivity.
A screenshot or video confirming the phone is unlocked and can use a different SIM card.
A video of the phone under load (e.g., gaming) to test battery and performance.
response.reason: While the model, storage, and battery health are confirmed, the claim of 'working perfectly' cannot be verified without functional proof. Hidden physical damage and software/hardware issues are significant risks that must be ruled out before pricing. The item can be priced only after these risks are addressed.
